about: The kept runs of the measure made with the current judge sentences (issue #399, D7). Authority is set by the bar on their counts pooled (lib/judges.mjs poolScores): the model samples at its default, and one run's flip of a verdict is noise. A run whose requests changed a sentence starts the pool again; a run that only stops asking a pass about a kind joins it. The newest run is the one tests/unit/judgeMeasure.test.js replays, and is as the module ships.
